summary.name: Summary
summary.content: Computer Science (IoT) engineer and 3x national hackathon winner (incl. Smart India Hackathon 2025) specializing in Python backend engineering, AI/LLM pipelines, test automation, and embedded systems. Experienced in building production REST APIs (FastAPI, Node.js, Django), multi-agent LLM workflows with rigorous output evaluation, and robotic computer vision.

items.summary:
Engineered production AI product-listing pipeline; scraped vendor URLs into MongoDB, structured outputs via Gemini 3.6 Flash Lite API for SEO metadata and HSN codes published to Zoho Commerce.
Designed FastAPI endpoints with Celery-backed async AI task execution, automated category suggestions, SKU deduplication, rate-limit resilience, and production MongoDB/Redis pooling.
Built autonomous pick-and-place system on MechArm Pi 270 (6-DOF arm) performing 360° scanning and OpenCV HSV color segmentation.
Optimized real-time OpenCV pipeline on Raspberry Pi 4B (2 GB RAM) at 10 FPS, reducing memory footprint by 75% via frame-skipping.
Implemented 30-iteration proportional visual servoing loop correcting yaw (Joint 1) and pitch (Joint 2) from pixel error.

Delivered Django backend routes, CRUD workflows, and real-time IoT sensor dashboards (DHT11, soil moisture, ultrasonic) integrated with live web interfaces; maintained codebase via Git pull-request review workflows.

Architected end-to-end sensor data management pipeline for precision agriculture; calibrated 5 industrial IoT sensor types and engineered real-time telemetry ingestion pipelines into centralized storage.

items.name: AmitAstro: Full-Stack Consultation Platform
items.description: Solo-built client platform with React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Socket.io, Gemini API, and PWA (30,000+ lines). Includes UPI/UTR verification queue, Telegram webhook alerts, fraud prevention, timezone-aware booking engine, and RSA-OAEP encryption.

items.name: AmitAstro Test Automation & AI-Output Evaluation Framework
items.description: Built 170+ automated tests across unit, database, REST API, real-time, and UI layers using Vitest, Supertest, and Playwright. Cross-database validation across SQLite and PostgreSQL via GitHub Actions CI service containers.

items.name: ARMA: Smart Farming IoT Pipeline & Analytics Dashboard
items.description: 5-stage Python ETL pipeline ingesting 4,300+ records into PostgreSQL star schema; cut query latency by 65%. 10 advanced SQL queries modelling 31% water savings. Fruit ripeness detection via OpenCV + YOLOv8.

items.name: Renewable Energy Grid Optimizer (SIH 2025 Winner)
items.description: Smart India Hackathon 2025 winning system: Real-time grid monitoring and automated phase-balancing algorithm on renewable distribution feeders using ESP32, PZEM-004T, LoRa, and Python dashboard.
